prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Lorena, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Lorena trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: SOFTEN: add doubt, or make the claim milder and less certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard from Mrs. Gable that the municipal pool might stay closed all summer due to those recurring water quality issues. It sounds exactly like the kind of neglect I’ve been warning about for years, so we should definitely verify this before heading over."
text: Mrs. Gable mentioned the pool might be closed all summer, though I’m skeptical since the staff usually keeps things running well. It’s probably worth double-checking before we make any plans.
